authoring: Assistant-authored scenario questions grounded in the frozen reviewed FAQ. Not independent human review or user traffic. Each triple authored explicitly, not combinatorial prefix/template padding.
split_unit: Scenario including all translations; FAQ topics appear in train/dev/cal/fresh. Wording/scenario generalization over the same searchable documents, not held-out-topic or unseen-document evaluation.
training: Original114 TRAIN + new TRAIN only; all old DEV/CAL/TEST/v2/v3 probes remain observed regression checks. Four identical v3 projected-SGD fits at rates .05/.15 x seeds42/97, 80epochs max/patience10, no new runtime features.
selection: New DEV only (per-language floor against lexical DEV), top1 then MRR then parameter count; same LEGACY/TITLE/RRF/UNIFORM controls. New CAL only selects minimum/margin/coverage, correct minus3wrong. Export before new FRESH scoring. Original dev/cal remain regression only.
